# What changed?
Brief summary of the scoped task and relevant issue.

## Why?
What problem does this solve? Include relevant requirements or design decisions.

## Changed files
Mention important files and why they changed.

## Verification (be truthful)
- [ ] Frontend checks run (or not applicable)
- [ ] Backend checks run (or not applicable)
- [ ] Manual behavior verified (or not applicable)

**Checks not run (and why):**

## Screenshots (for UI changes)
Before / after images or a short description.

## Risks and limitations
Known issues, follow-ups, or dependencies.

## Agent use (if applicable)
Agent(s) used, implementation scope, and whether Codex reviewed a focused diff. Do not assert an independent review unless it happened.

## Reviewer checklist
- [ ] Changes are within the task's scope
- [ ] Shared code and UI standards followed
- [ ] Critical changes received architecture/human review
- [ ] Source labels and SOS/guard statuses are accurate

**Target branch:** `elson` during the current migration period. Only the project lead approves merges to `main`.
